title: 📋 Several Admin & Clerical Openings Around Rochester, NY - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Rochester’s admin job scene is busy right now—lots of offices, schools, and healthcare groups need organized people who keep things running smoothly.
Here are several solid admin & clerical roles hiring now in Rochester, NY :
Administrative Assistant Employer: Insero Talent Solutions
Location: Rochester, NY (in-office)
Type: Full-time
Salary: Not listed
Support a busy professional services office with document prep, scheduling, mail, supplies, and client greetings. Nice perks here: 4 weeks PTO, 16 paid holidays, 401(k) with firm contributions, and 100% paid parking .
Administrative Coordinator, Student and Adjunct Staff Employer: Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) – Recreation & Wellness
Location: Rochester, NY (on campus)
Type: Full-time, non-exempt
Pay: $19.65–$24.29/hour
Senior-level admin role helping manage 400+ student employees and 100+ adjunct staff —hiring, onboarding, payroll, training, and events. Great fit if you like campus life and staff development.
Admissions Operations Specialist Employer: RIT – Admissions
Location: Rochester, NY (hybrid)
Type: Full-time, non-exempt
Pay: $17.90–$22.00/hour
Help run the admissions process: process applications, manage student records, answer student/family questions, and help with campus visit events. Good match if you like a fast-paced, customer-focused office.
Policy, University Council, and Faculty Senate Coordinator Employer: RIT – Office of the Provost
Location: Rochester, NY (on campus)
Type: Full-time, non-exempt
Pay: $19.65–$31.45/hour
High-level admin role supporting University Council and Faculty Senate —meeting logistics, minutes, agendas, and managing university policies and policy website. Great for detail-oriented admins comfortable handling confidential info .
